file: content/works/David Keeffe - The Undone Years. Flood.md

sources.evidence: No products available; no recordings or sheet music held; inquiries directed to composer or agent. Confirms tenor saxophone and wind ensemble and different Fire orchestration.
Composer catalog searched for Flood, with no matching records among its 20 entries.
Homepage identifies David Keeffe and links his Australian Music Centre artist page and Wirripang profile.
Live represented-artist profile links composer website and Wirripang. No direct composer contact or Flood ordering route. Australian Music Centre contact is available for help locating the composer.

findings: Live Australian Music Centre page identifies Flood (2010), tenor saxophone and wind ensemble, and explicitly reports no sheet music or products. It directs inquiries to the composer or agent. Composer music catalog search for Flood found no matching records.
uncertainty: No sale or rental route verified. Fire has different orchestration and cannot substitute for Flood. Complete conductor score, solo part and wind ensemble parts remain unverified.
next_action: Ask Australian Music Centre for the current composer or agent contact, then confirm Flood materials and purchase or rental availability.
suggested_inquiry: Could you help locate the current composer or agent contact for The Undone Years: Flood (2010), tenor saxophone and wind ensemble? The work page has no products and directs inquiries to the composer. I need to confirm purchase or rental and obtain the conductor score, tenor solo part and all wind ensemble parts. Flood specifically is required; Fire has different orchestration.
